docs: The gravitational pull of the Moon, and to a lesser degree the Sun, raises bulges in the oceans; as the Earth rotates, coasts pass through them, giving two high tides a day.
Spring tides happen when the Sun and Moon line up at new and full moon, so their tidal forces add; neap tides happen when they are at right angles.
Tides are the regular rise and fall of sea level, measured by tide gauges in most harbours.
The Bay of Fundy in Canada has some of the highest tidal ranges in the world, over 15 metres.
Ocean currents such as the Gulf Stream are driven by wind and differences in water density.
Surfing competitions are often scheduled around the tide tables of a beach.
The Moon's phases are caused by the changing angle between the Sun, the Earth and the Moon.
Tidal power plants convert the energy of moving water into electricity.
mRNA vaccines deliver instructions in a lipid nanoparticle; cells read the mRNA and make a harmless piece of the virus's spike protein, which trains the immune system to recognise it.
After vaccination, the injected mRNA is broken down within days and never enters the cell nucleus or changes DNA.
Vaccines expose the immune system to an antigen so that it builds memory B and T cells.
The first mRNA vaccines approved for wide use were against COVID-19.
Antibiotics treat bacterial infections and have no effect on viruses.
Cold chain logistics keep vaccines at the temperature their label requires.
Messenger RNA was discovered in 1961.
Hand washing reduces the spread of many respiratory infections.
Yes. list.sort() and sorted() are guaranteed to be stable: items that compare equal keep their original relative order, which makes multi-key sorts in several passes possible.
Python's sort uses Timsort, a stable hybrid of merge sort and insertion sort.
list.sort() sorts a list in place and returns None; sorted() returns a new list.
The key argument of sorted() takes a function that is applied to each element before comparison.
NumPy's default sort is quicksort, which is not stable; pass kind='stable' to get a stable sort.
Python dictionaries keep insertion order since version 3.7.
A stable marriage matching can be found with the Gale-Shapley algorithm.
Lists in Python can hold elements of different types.
